policy: v13 KF8 重烧 v2：上一版模型让真人走进画面，与玻璃倒影里的她同框=两个人，逻辑崩。本版写死『画面里只有展柜和玻璃上的反射，没有任何人站在展柜前』。

units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A locked-off medium shot of a museum vitrine behind glass; the framing stays exactly as the first frame and the camera holds perfectly still. A cracked black basalt tablet covered in carved wedge marks stands upright inside the case, warm tungsten halogen at 3000K raking across it from above, the gallery beyond falling to warm black. Nobody stands in front of the case: the young woman with long dark hair appears only as a faint reflection painted on the dark glass, kept exactly where it is in the first frame. Across the take the reflection's eyes travel slowly left to right along one band of wedge marks, and around one second a small breath of fog blooms on the cold glass beside her reflected cheek and fades away. Nothing else moves: no second person enters the shot, the tablet stays perfectly still, the reflection does not walk and does not turn away from the glass. Fine 35mm grain, warm halation along the glass edge, black point slightly lifted, the same hall and the same lighting as the first frame.
